assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: canonical full-body character seed for a 2D top-down horror RPG animation pipeline
Input images: Image 1 is the approved identity and costume reference for Damián Ferreyra; preserve his recognizable adult face, short tousled black hair, dark brown eyes, beard stubble, skin tone, off-white archivist shirt, and charcoal undershirt.
Primary request: Create one original full-body standing seed of the same Damián Ferreyra, clearly a 35-year-old Argentine adult night archivist, ready to be used as the master reference for later idle, walk, and interact sprites.
Subject: coherent realistic adult proportions; practical dark slate work trousers with visible belt, worn brown-black work boots, sleeves rolled to the forearms; both complete arms, hands, legs, feet, neck, head, and hair fully visible and naturally connected.
Style/medium: premium dark Anime HD game character illustration with painterly texture and clean, stable readable linework, matching Image 1 exactly in visual language and identity.
Composition/framing: single character only, straight-on neutral standing pose, head-to-toe centered, arms held slightly away from torso, feet shoulder-width apart and aligned on the same baseline, symmetrical readable silhouette, generous padding on every edge. No perspective distortion and no cropped anatomy.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local background removal.
Lighting/mood: neutral soft frontal studio light on the character only; preserve subtle graphite-and-amber shading but no colored spill from the backdrop.
Constraints: preserve identity and outfit from Image 1; background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation; do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject; no cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, weapon, prop, text, letters, logos, signature, watermark, UI, blood, gore, sexual content, or childlike features.
Avoid: extra limbs, hidden hands, cropped feet, duplicate character, dynamic pose, foreshortening, loose coat tails, translucent elements, smoke, hair crossing the outer silhouette excessively, photorealism, chibi, fantasy armor.

Asset type: 16:9 fixed-room exploration background for a 2D top-down psychological-horror RPG
Primary request: Create the empty “Vestíbulo de Santa Ágata,” the abandoned entrance lobby of a sealed Argentine clinical-memory facility at night.
Scene/backdrop: rain lashes tall reinforced windows along one wall; incomplete fluorescent tubes; a broad reception counter covered with damp anonymous forms; wall-mounted intake terminal; emergency cable leading toward a closed freight lift; stained ceramic-and-concrete surfaces; subtle clinical neglect. No readable writing.
Subject: the room itself, designed as a navigable game space with a large clear central floor, obvious reception interaction zone, visible lift destination, and safe readable paths.
Style/medium: premium dark Anime HD environment painting with painterly texture, crisp architectural silhouettes, grounded materials, and restrained detail; visually consistent with a serious RPG Maker-style horror game.
Composition/framing: exact-feeling 16:9 wide landscape, high three-quarter top-down view with near-orthographic fixed-room perspective, entire playable room visible, stable geometry, level horizon, no fisheye, no cutaway labels. Keep the middle floor comparatively uncluttered for player sprites and interaction markers.
Lighting/mood: motivated broken fluorescent pools, cold surgical-teal reflections from wet glass, warning-amber emergency accents, deep but readable graphite corners, restrained bloom, oppressive rain-soaked stillness.
Color palette: wet graphite #11151D, surgical teal #5AC8D8, warning amber #E4A24A, tiny restrained blood-crimson #A62F45 accents, bone #F1E8D6 highlights.
Constraints: empty environment; no people, creatures, bodies, gore, weapons, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermark, border, visible tile grid, map markers, or remote-world scenery; maintain clear floor contrast so dark character sprites remain readable.
Avoid: photorealism, fantasy architecture, cyberpunk neon overload, Dutch angle, extreme perspective, clutter blocking traversal, duplicate doors, impossible stairs, bright daylight, generic hotel lobby.
